methodology.monte_carlo: block bootstrap of holdout net returns; annualized Sharpe per path
methodology.cost_sweep: half-side unit cost × factor; net = gross - trade_intensity·unit·factor
methodology.regime: ADX vs min_adx; ATR% vs sample median; net Sharpe per bucket
methodology.anchored_wf: expanding train, quarterly grid re-optimization by in-sample net Sharpe

pass_criteria.regime: >=2 ADX & >=2 vol buckets positive; no >85% pnl concentration with others negative
pass_criteria.anchored_wf: concatenated OOS net Sharpe > 0 and >=50% folds positive
